def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Balance greedy KVPR placement, then apply the single best global improving relocation."""
    placement = {g: [] for g in range(gpu_num)}
    remaining = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    def pressure(demand, memory):
        return demand / memory if memory > 0 else float("inf")

    for model in sorted(models, key=lambda m: m.req_rate / m.slo, reverse=True):
        demand = model.req_rate / model.slo
        gpu = min(
            (g for g in range(gpu_num) if model.model_size <= remaining[g]),
            key=lambda g: pressure(load[g], remaining[g]),
            default=None,
        )
        if gpu is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Unable to place model of size {model.model_size} GB.")
        placement[gpu].append(model)
        load[gpu] += demand
        remaining[gpu] -= model.model_size

    best_score = max(pressure(load[g], remaining[g]) for g in range(gpu_num))
    best_move = None

    for source in range(gpu_num):
        for model in placement[source]:
            demand = model.req_rate / model.slo
            size = model.model_size
            for target in range(gpu_num):
                if source == target or size > remaining[target]:
                    continue

                other = max(
                    (pressure(load[g], remaining[g]) for g in range(gpu_num)
                     if g != source and g != target),
                    default=0.0,
                )
                score = max(
                    other,
                    pressure(load[source] - demand, remaining[source] + size),
                    pressure(load[target] + demand, remaining[target] - size),
                )
                if score < best_score:
                    best_score = score
                    best_move = source, target, model

    if best_move is not None:
        source, target, model = best_move
        placement[source].remove(model)
        placement[target].append(model)

    return placement

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
